permit-exception: Main request duty retains missing-required-report condition and valid-exemption exception, with correct reviewing-officer duty bearer.

A deadline-containing unit retains at least ten working days for a response, linked explicitly to the missing-report request for a non-exempt application. A separate generic threshold for all report requests does not pass this standalone-unit criterion.

Workshop example retains inherited missing-report condition and exemption. Review whether its separately usable meaning also retains the governing deadline; record that separately from the main duty/deadline check.
broader-deadline: Main and workshop request duties retain missing-required-report condition and valid-exemption exception.
Deadline retains at least ten working days and its express application to every inspection-report request, including voluntary requests for exempt applicants. Do not narrow it to mandatory requests.
The broader deadline must not turn voluntary requests for exempt applicants into a duty to request reports.

representation: Assess compliance separately: split arm should emit the deadline separately; group arm should combine the deadline with its duty when scopes match and keep different scopes separate. Grouping must not hide missing meaning; fewer records is not a quality score.
decision: A useful grouping result requires both grouped same-scope runs to retain the main duty/deadline meaning and both grouped broader-scope runs to retain the scope distinction without a new obligation. Compare fresh split controls; all-pass in both arms shows no measured advantage. Record residual independently extracted example omissions and actor ambiguity even if the narrow main-duty gate passes.
budget: Eight calls only: two cases x two strategies x two repeats, Gemini gemini-3.8-flash, medium thinking, temperature zero, no numeric thinking budget or application output cap. No retries, repairs, prompt tuning or production changes.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures and agent source review; not a full production extraction evaluation. Both arms add common dependency guidance to the previously successful example schema, so this experiment compares grouping strategies, not the effect of all new guidance against production.
common_guidance: Preserve all governing conditions, exceptions, modal force and time limits in each independently usable meaning. A deadline does not itself create a duty to perform the action. If the source gives a deadline a different scope from the duty, preserve that distinction.

strategy_guidance.split: Represent a deadline separately from the duty it qualifies.
strategy_guidance.group: Represent a deadline together with the duty it qualifies, unless their scopes differ; in that case, represent them separately.
